mechanisms.summary: Exact PLQ and lost return path PLQMP
boundaries: Exact supplied rational operators and orthogonal projection. Identity certificate does not approve nonzero closure defect. No unknown-process claim.

mechanisms.summary: Smallest common operator-invariant row space containing initial observables
boundaries: Bounded exact row refinement; incomplete round caps withhold approval. Operators and augmented observables must be available.

mechanisms.summary: Finite discrete projection memory BD^kC with initial forcing BD^tq0
boundaries: Finite stated horizon and exact history. Geometric tail and stable recursive truncation conditions are not certified by this primitive.

mechanisms.summary: Exact known-observation-map rank criterion and delay factorization
boundaries: Autonomous known finite operator. A sampled data rank plateau does not establish true closure. Transition unique only on im O_h.

mechanisms.summary: Consistency, observed-span closure and unknown global coverage separated
boundaries: Sample fit and full supplied ambient span cannot authenticate an unknown larger realizable space. global_coverage remains not_established.

mechanisms.summary: Complete finite packet reconstruction, transfer blocks, composition and refinement
boundaries: Existing exact/numerical backends retain their own contracts. Atlas-wide coherence is not supplied by packet reconstruction alone.

mechanisms.summary: Multilinear packet jet interactions and finite polynomial/Taylor reconstruction
boundaries: Restricted multilinear norms and omitted interaction bounds require declared hypotheses. No unrestricted invariant nonlinear dictionary discovery.

mechanisms.summary: Finite Bayesian aggregation and sufficient likelihood partitions
boundaries: Existing implementation numerical; two-or-more-block necessity boundary must be retained. Joint transition/likelihood lumpability is not claimed implemented here.

mechanisms.summary: Lossless redundant atlases and coherent object-space reconciliation
boundaries: Matrix realization primitives exist but no complete library atlas/coherence reconciliation API was verified in this extraction.

mechanisms.summary: Coarsest joint transition and observation-likelihood closure
boundaries: Known finite row-stochastic model and positive likelihoods. Not implemented by the likelihood-only existing partition helper.

mechanisms.summary: Perturbation, defect propagation and stable finite-memory bounds
boundaries: Finite data coverage and true-model, norm, noise and contraction hypotheses remain conditional. Existing continuous-time MemoryKernel is a related but different API.

mechanisms.summary: Controlled instruments, table reconstruction, positivity, normalization and reset sampling
boundaries: Full behavior-rank upper bound and experiment coverage not inferred from finite table invertibility. No unrestricted model identification.

mechanisms.summary: Finite cone/lift witnesses, robust vertices, correction and observation-law bounds
boundaries: Existential finite witness versus robust quantified certificate distinct. Search failure is inconclusive; some valid finite-rank processes have no polyhedral certificate.

mechanisms.summary: Matrix embedding, polynomial Gram positivity, continuous operator densities and moment reconstruction
boundaries: Explicit embedding, observation interval and reference measure. Finite degree/rank hypotheses and exact population event tables required. No generic SDP solver.

mechanisms.summary: Oriented quadratic certificates, restricted geometry discovery, positive approximation and predictable residuals
boundaries: Restricted exact template-free proposals; no general noisy geometry discovery. Statistical nonrejection is not an upper adequacy guarantee.

mechanisms.summary: Rational semicircle and complete Bernstein subdivision proofs, coefficient boxes and repair brackets
boundaries: Deterministic repaired-family uncertainty is not a statistically covered set for the original process. Nominal validity, comparison domain and law error remain separate.

mechanisms.summary: Self-normalized regression, fixed observable moment states, rational whole-box confidence and marginal bounds
boundaries: Declared accessible dictionary/state, fixed parameters, conditional noise and reference measure. Saved five-node path is not continuous data. No coverage-rate claim from one seeded path.

mechanisms.summary: Conditional expectation refinement, strong fixed-horizon limits and information/grammar boundaries
boundaries: Infinite-dimensional convergence and general unknown dictionary/geometry discovery remain mathematical hypotheses or research directions, not unrestricted executable APIs.
